digest.component_or_area: type checking configuration and mypy ratchet
propositions: Mypy 2.3.0 at commit 0f5dbc88b reports one redundant-cast diagnostic at editor.py:515 despite two adjacent cast() calls, requiring investigation and selective removal

24 unused-ignore diagnostics are observed across 20 source files in the rebar_reconciler and related modules, each requiring per-ignore revalidation in the canonical fully provisioned CI environment before removal

Four mypy strictness flags (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be globally enabled in configuration while deliberately deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs
A ratchet test must assert the four approved strictness flags are enabled and the two deferred flags are not, preventing regression of type safety configuration
